sentence_en: There is no simple explanation for the evolution of a species.
sentence_zh: 一个物种的演化没有简单的解释。

sentence_en: Places where there are no human inhabitants are becoming rarer and rarer throughout the world.
sentence_zh: 世界上无人居住的地方越来越少了。

sentence_en: The biodiversity of the earth is becoming smaller due to the constant extinction of species.
sentence_zh: 由于物种不断灭绝，地球的生物多样性正在减少。

sentence_en: The reason that many governments will not allow plants or produce to go through customs is because they do not want an alien species to disrupt the natural ecosystem in their country.
sentence_zh: 许多政府不允许植物或农产品通关，是因为不想让外来物种破坏本国的自然生态系统。

sentence_en: There are many interesting creatures in the sea, including dolphins, whales, starfish, seahorses and eels!
sentence_zh: 海里有很多有趣的生物，比如海豚、鲸、海星、海马和鳗鱼！

sentence_en: The age of an artifact as old as this one can only be determined by radiocarbon dating.
sentence_zh: 这么古老的文物，只能用放射性碳测年来确定年代。

sentence_en: The biodiversity of the earth is being threatened by the continued expansion of human settlements and the excessive use of natural resources.
sentence_zh: 人类聚居地不断扩张、自然资源被过度使用，正威胁着地球的生物多样性。

sentence_en: The sun is so hot in the Australian desert that a glass of water vaporizes in no time.
sentence_zh: 澳大利亚沙漠里太阳太毒，一杯水转眼就蒸发了。

sentence_en: The weather in Southern England is mostly nice and balmy.
sentence_zh: 英格兰南部的天气大多宜人温暖。

sentence_en: The logging of the forest inadvertently exposed the remains and artifacts of a once lost culture.
sentence_zh: 森林砍伐无意中让一种失落文化的遗迹和文物重见天日。

sentence_en: 1 out of 48 Australians have German heritage.
sentence_zh: 每 48 个澳大利亚人中就有 1 个有德国血统。

sentence_en: The reason he studied archaeology in college is because he has dreams of going to faraway countries as an archaeologist to find dinosaur remains.
sentence_zh: 他大学学考古，是因为梦想以考古学家的身份去遥远的国家寻找恐龙遗骸。

sentence_en: Long before humans evolved, giant, prehistoric creatures resembling lizards roamed the world.
sentence_zh: 早在人类出现之前，像蜥蜴一样的巨型史前生物就在世界上游荡。

meaning_zh: （尤指具有考古价值的）人工制品（英式拼写 artefact）
sentence_en: The museum has many artifacts from ancient Chinese dynasties.
sentence_zh: 这家博物馆有很多中国古代王朝的文物。

sentence_en: When a kangaroo's baby is young, the mother kangaroo puts the joey in her pouch.
sentence_zh: 袋鼠宝宝小的时候，袋鼠妈妈会把它放在育儿袋里。

sentence_en: When you consider how large the Milky Way is, it is simply amazing to consider that there are also countless other galaxies in the universe.
sentence_zh: 想想银河系有多大，再想到宇宙中还有无数其他星系，真是不可思议。

sentence_en: In the desert it is important to find ways to escape the torrid heat.
sentence_zh: 在沙漠里，想办法躲避酷热很重要。

sentence_en: Sediment that forms in river estuaries is an excellent source of fossils.
sentence_zh: 河口形成的沉积物是化石的极好来源。

sentence_en: Because the water in lagoons is much calmer, they are a great place to go swimming.
sentence_zh: 礁湖里的水平静得多，所以是游泳的好地方。

sentence_en: The weather on the tropical island where we took our vacation was absolutely sultry.
sentence_zh: 我们度假的那个热带岛屿天气闷热极了。

sentence_en: The air during the winter is a little nippy.
sentence_zh: 冬天的空气有点冷。

sentence_en: I like to visit places that have interesting topographical features, like mountains or canyons.
sentence_zh: 我喜欢去地形有趣的地方，比如山脉或峡谷。

sentence_en: In some places in the Rocky Mountain National Park you can see a panoramic view of the ranges as they stretch out across the horizon.
sentence_zh: 在落基山国家公园的一些地方，你能看到山脉向地平线绵延的全景。

sentence_en: The peninsula juts out into the ocean for two miles.
sentence_zh: 这个半岛向海中伸出两英里。

sentence_en: There are many small islands in the archipelago north of the main island of Japan.
sentence_zh: 日本本岛以北的群岛中有许多小岛。

sentence_en: Most people think that prairies are boring because they are so flat, but actually you can find many interesting life forms there.
sentence_zh: 大多数人觉得大草原太平坦很无聊，其实那里有很多有趣的生物。

sentence_en: After the beautiful drive through the mountains, we were disappointed to come down and see the plains.
sentence_zh: 在山间美美地开了一路车后，下山看到平原让我们有些失望。

sentence_en: The mountain range extending from North-Eastern to South-Eastern Australia is known as 'The Great Dividing Range'.
sentence_zh: 从澳大利亚东北部延伸到东南部的山脉被称为“大分水岭”。

sentence_en: Our farm is on the side of a large marsh, so our soil is very good for growing crops.
sentence_zh: 我们的农场在一大片沼泽边上，所以土壤很适合种庄稼。

meaning_zh: 多年生的；四季不断的；多年生植物
sentence_en: Perennial plants are the easiest to grow because you don't have to replant them every year.
sentence_zh: 多年生植物最好种，因为不用每年重新栽种。

sentence_en: Meteorologists have kept accurate records of weather conditions for over 100 years.
sentence_zh: 气象学家对天气状况的准确记录已经保持了 100 多年。

sentence_en: Before meteorology, people had very little advance warning of large storms that were on their way over.
sentence_zh: 在有气象学之前，人们对即将来袭的大风暴几乎没有预警。

sentence_en: Methane gas leaks are hard to detect because methane is odorless.
sentence_zh: 沼气泄漏很难察觉，因为甲烷没有气味。

meaning_zh: 两栖动物；两栖的，水陆两用的
sentence_en: Amphibians such as frogs are fast on both land and water.
sentence_zh: 青蛙之类的两栖动物在陆地和水中都很敏捷。

meaning_zh: 依年代先后顺序排列的
sentence_en: The major natural disasters across history have been recorded in chronological order as well as in order of destructive power.
sentence_zh: 历史上的重大自然灾害既按时间顺序、也按破坏力大小记录了下来。

sentence_en: Despite the continuing birth of offspring, the largest sea mammal known as the blue whale is under threat of extinction.
sentence_zh: 尽管不断有幼崽出生，最大的海洋哺乳动物蓝鲸仍面临灭绝威胁。
